plan.tagline: Track competitor hotel rates across Booking.com, Agoda, Airbnb from CLI
plan.problem: Phuket hotel managers manually check OTA prices daily, missing rate changes and losing bookings to cheaper competitors.
plan.solution: CLI tool to log competitor rates, spot trends, and alert when prices drop below threshold.
plan.target_market: Small hotels and guesthouses in Phuket ($99-199/night range)
mvp_features: Add competitors with name, OTA, and base rate
Alert when competitor drops below your rate

build_phases.name: Core DB & CLI
build_phases.description: SQLite schema for hotels, rates, alerts + add/log/list commands

build_phases.name: Alerts & Reports
build_phases.description: Threshold alerts, trend analysis, weekly digest

build_phases.name: Demo & Polish
build_phases.description: --demo with realistic Phuket hotel data, formatted dashboard

plan.demo_script: python main.py --demo: adds 3 Phuket competitors → logs rates → triggers alert → shows dashboard
